name: Kelen Kelune
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: First clear clinical distinction between smallpox and measles, and an early sceptic of alchemy as transmutation while doing the chemistry anyway.
text: Kelen kelune of the turned key, keeps the book for the 18th tranche, doors 162 to 171. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads Al-Razi (Rhazes).
